instructions: Resolve each decision in its assigned phase using the required evidence. Record the selected decision and affected downstream artefacts in the phase review.

decisions.question: Which users, workflows and outcomes define success for the library and Windows product?
decisions.current_direction: Standalone beam design in Excel is first; reusable Python and .NET use and later ETABS automation are required.

decision_record.selected_direction: Maintain native Python and native .NET libraries for a deliberately selected common semantic capability set. Deliver standalone IS 456 reinforced-concrete beam design in Windows Excel first, while preserving normal library use. Add the ETABS snapshot, checking, candidate search, controlled reanalysis and construction-output loop around the same reusable services.
downstream_effects: PF1 must detail standalone Excel, direct Python, direct .NET, ETABS automation, construction-output and review journeys.
PF2 must classify existing Python and C# surfaces before reuse or migration.
PF3-PF7 must define complete engineering scope, meaning, professional operations and assurance before new API implementation.
PF8 keeps Excel and ETABS as application adapters around immutable library contracts.
PF9 establishes numeric runtime and performance budgets rather than inferring performance from C#.
PF11 produces the first bounded implementation packet only after all definition evidence is integrated.

decisions.question: Which real workflows and information handoffs must the system support?
decisions.current_direction: Cover standalone design, ordinary library use, ETABS intake, coupled redesign, fabrication and reporting.

decision_record.selected_direction: Use six authoritative workflows: standalone Excel, direct Python, direct .NET, ETABS automation, construction output, and review/correction. Pure libraries and worksheet calculations consume explicit immutable data; Excel and ETABS effects are commands. Construction outputs require current resolved reinforcement and declared policies.
downstream_effects: PF3 maps every capability and AO operation to these workflows.
PF8 preserves the command and immutable-snapshot boundaries.
PF10 documentation includes one journey for each user route.

decisions.question: Which existing functions and contracts should be retained, corrected, wrapped, replaced or omitted?
decisions.current_direction: Reuse only after semantic and evidence review; do not port by existence alone.

decision_record.selected_direction: Use selective reuse: retain bounded pure kernels and traceability controls, correct engineering meaning before migration, compatibility-wrap recoverable published behavior, replace application/transport implementations where semantics differ, and omit unrelated or advisory features from the initial beam common set.
downstream_effects: PF3 selects capabilities from workflow demand and evidence rather than code existence.
PF7 promotes numerical behavior only with source and independent assurance.
PF10 gives every current surface a compatibility or migration route.

decisions.question: What is the maintained capability set and where is each boundary?
decisions.current_direction: Keep pure calculations and reusable member/fabrication/search services in libraries; keep application state and rendering in adapters.

decision_record.selected_direction: Use 17 capability families with strict dependency direction from core contracts through design-code calculations and reusable services to application adapters. Whole-member design, reinforcement resolution, BBS data, quantities, search and calculation records are reusable; Excel, ETABS, mutation and rendering remain adapters.
downstream_effects: PF5 operations bind to explicit capability owners.
PF6 maps reusable operations to both native libraries.
PF8 owns application effects.

decisions.question: What beam types, section forms, analysis scopes and code profiles are initially supported?
decisions.current_direction: Begin from the agreed ordinary reinforced-concrete beam profile, while the definition covers extension points and explicit applicability.

decision_record.selected_direction: Start with explicit foundations, bounded planar beam-line analysis, ordinary rectangular and eligible flanged IS 456 sections, and one or more collinear spans with complete strength, serviceability, detailing, fit and construction data. Add seismic detailing and ETABS-connected use after the ordinary standalone slice; special beams, global analysis, other codes and formwork temporary-works design require separate profiles.
downstream_effects: PF7 assigns evidence by supported profile.
PF8 cannot broaden engineering applicability.
PF11 work packets follow the profile order.

decisions.question: What quantity, unit, sign, axis, station and physical-face conventions are normative?
decisions.current_direction: Use explicit dimensional names, one internal unit policy and adapter-owned conversions with physical-face mapping.

decision_record.selected_direction: Use the PF4 quantity dictionary and boundary units; preserve signed concurrent P/V2/V3/T/M2/M3 rows and source axes; map physical faces through explicit geometry and adapter transforms; retain physical and analysis station identities.
downstream_effects: PF5 signatures reference semantic quantities.
PF7 tolerances are quantity-specific.
PF8 adapters return unit/axis transforms.

decisions.question: How are optional, absent, defaulted, derived and conflicting values represented?
decisions.current_direction: Use explicit choices and return effective inputs; never use zero or blank as an undeclared default request.

decision_record.selected_direction: Classify fields as required, conditional, profile-resolved or cosmetic and distinguish absent, null, blank, zero, supplied, defaulted, derived and conflicting states. Return every effective engineering value with origin.
downstream_effects: PF5 requests name field obligations and defaults.
PF8 maps Excel blanks before typed calculation.
PF10 compatibility translations expose effective values.

decisions.question: How are engineering result states and completeness represented?
decisions.current_direction: Separate invalid input, software failure, engineering failure, inapplicability and unevaluated required checks.

decision_record.selected_direction: Represent execution, applicability, engineering outcome, completeness, freshness and human approval independently. Invalid input, software error, fail, not applicable and not evaluated cannot substitute for one another.
downstream_effects: PF5 result envelopes carry all dimensions.
PF7 defines conservative aggregation.
PF8 and reports cannot show partial/stale outcomes as current approval.

decisions.question: How are raw artifacts, normalized inputs, calculation executions and revisions identified?
decisions.current_direction: Use distinct identities; do not treat a serializer-dependent hash with acquisition time as a universal calculation key.

decision_record.selected_direction: Use separate raw-artifact, acquisition, model, analysis, normalized-input, calculation, result, detail, report and code-data identities. Canonical effective inputs use versioned unit-normalized JSON and SHA-256; event time and presentation do not enter the normalized-input key unless they are engineering inputs.
downstream_effects: PF6 defines shared schemas and conformance fixtures.
PF8 snapshots and transactions bind source identities.
PF10 versions semantic and code-data dependencies separately.

decisions.question: Which API levels and naming/signature rules make the library both professional and usable?
decisions.current_direction: Offer small value functions, typed checks, design/selection, member services and explicit adapter commands.

decision_record.selected_direction: Expose separate value, capacity, check, design, member-service and adapter-command levels plus human approval records. Project common semantic IDs into idiomatic snake_case Python and PascalCase C# without changing meanings or defaults.
downstream_effects: PF6 chooses native/common implementation per semantic operation.
PF8 defines Excel projections and commands.
PF10 migrates legacy names through explicit wrappers.

decisions.question: What must every public operation specify?
decisions.current_direction: Purpose, applicability, fields, units, signs, conditionality, optional resolution, effective inputs, outputs, diagnostics, provenance, examples and compatibility.

decision_record.selected_direction: Every operation declares semantic/version identity, profile/applicability, typed request, effective inputs, structured result states, outputs, diagnostics, provenance, compatibility and both valid and non-success examples. Expected non-success is data, not free-text exception control flow.
downstream_effects: PF7 creates evidence for each operation.
PF10 documentation and migration use the same contract.
PF11 rejects work items without a complete operation contract.

decisions.question: How will native Python and native .NET implementations stay aligned?
decisions.current_direction: Maintain a deliberate common semantic set, shared normalized data/examples and cross-language conformance, with idiomatic projections.

decision_record.selected_direction: Define parity per semantic operation using equivalent canonical effective inputs, result states, provenance, independently qualified expected values and quantity tolerances. Implement reusable operations natively and idiomatically in Python and .NET; retain Excel/ETABS as .NET Windows adapters over portable contracts and snapshots.
downstream_effects: PF7 provides the oracle/tolerance side of parity.
PF8 application adapters expose portable requests/snapshots/receipts.
PF9 packages pure and adapter dependencies separately.

decisions.question: Which schema/data artefacts are authored, generated and versioned?
decisions.current_direction: Semantic meaning is reviewed first; generated transport projections cannot become the sole domain authority.

decision_record.selected_direction: Author and review semantic manifests, interchange schemas, normalized code data, conformance vectors and projection maps. Handwrite domain records/invariants and engineering algorithms in both languages. Generate only transport/validation/reference bindings reproducibly from those authorities.
downstream_effects: PF7 vectors bind all semantic/schema/profile/data revisions.
PF10 versions each authority distinctly.
PF11 implementation packets include regeneration and drift checks.

decisions.question: What evidence is sufficient for each calculation and combined member decision?
decisions.current_direction: Use source-traced worked examples, boundary/interpolation cases, invariants, independent oracles and language conformance vectors.

decision_record.selected_direction: Assign every AO operation a minimum evidence level, source references, assurance method and independent oracle. Require E4 for engineering calculations, E5 for installed Excel/ETABS behavior and retain E3 cross-language agreement only as correlation. Freeze and retain every expected member leaf before aggregation.
downstream_effects: PF8 installed scenarios are E5-only claims.
PF9 release evidence names operation coverage.
PF11 acceptance matrices cite evidence levels and corpus cases.

decisions.question: What tolerances and comparison rules apply to examples and parity?
decisions.current_direction: Define quantity-specific absolute/relative rules from engineering meaning and numerical method.

decision_record.selected_direction: Use exact equality for states/IDs/choices, quantity-specific absolute-plus-relative rules for unrounded values, separate source-precision comparison, exact raw-value limit decisions and decimal currency arithmetic. Compare both implementations to an independent oracle as well as to each other.
downstream_effects: PF6 conformance controls use stable tolerance IDs.
PF9 benchmarks cannot reuse numerical tolerances as performance margins.
PF10 examples show raw and display values separately.

decisions.question: What makes an ETABS action record suitable for a particular check?
decisions.current_direction: Preserve source/case/step/station/axis data and explicitly classify static vectors, steps, component envelopes, response results and design envelopes.

decision_record.selected_direction: A suitable row binds source model/analysis/result epoch, case/combination/step, object and element station, units, axes, face mapping and the same-row signed P/V2/V3/T/M2/M3 values. Each operation declares accepted action bases; component envelopes cannot silently satisfy concurrent interaction checks.
downstream_effects: AO16 must emit the complete vendor-neutral snapshot.
AO06-AO13 enforce accepted action bases.
PF9 installed matrix identifies the exact adapter/runtime.

decisions.question: Which Excel surfaces are pure worksheet functions and which are explicit commands?
decisions.current_direction: Pure calculations consume validated immutable data; import, COM access, mutation, analysis and file/report creation are commands.

decision_record.selected_direction: Expose small value/check and bounded table calculations as pure functions over explicit immutable input. Run project/workbook orchestration, member design, optimization, ETABS work, controlled writes, report export and performance measurement as explicit cancellable commands with receipts.
downstream_effects: PF9 packages Excel-DNA only in the Windows adapter.
PF10 provides separate function and command documentation.
PF11 work starts with host-free operations before the workbook adapter.

decisions.question: When does candidate evaluation require ETABS reanalysis?
decisions.current_direction: Fixed-demand reinforcement search can reuse actions; changes to section, stiffness, releases or global model inputs require a new snapshot.

decision_record.selected_direction: Reuse a frozen action snapshot only for reinforcement/detail/path/rate/report changes. Section, material/stiffness, release, offset, mass/self-weight, load, support, mesh or analysis changes require an identified owned copy, dry-run/readback, reanalysis, new result epoch and new snapshot; unknown coupling prevents evaluation.
downstream_effects: AO21 classifies every candidate before evaluation.
AO22 implements a single-use copied-model transaction.
PF9 and PF11 acceptance include fixed-action and coupled workloads.

decisions.question: Which runtimes, packages and optional dependencies are supported?
decisions.current_direction: Pure packages remain free of Excel/ETABS dependencies; Windows adapters isolate Excel-DNA and CSI API requirements.

decision_record.selected_direction: Support CPython 3.11-3.14 with Python 3.14 claimed only after its package matrix passes; use .NET 10 LTS for new .NET libraries and Windows adapters; make Windows 11 x64, 64-bit Microsoft 365 Excel, Excel-DNA 1.9.0 and the matching .NET 10 Desktop Runtime the primary XLL target; isolate Excel and CSI dependencies in optional adapter artifacts; qualify each exact ETABS executable/API tuple independently.
downstream_effects: Pure Python and .NET packages have no Excel, ETABS, COM, FastAPI or UI dependency.
XLL and ETABS distributions carry exact runtime, bitness, vendor and build evidence.
Office LTSC 2024 and additional ETABS tuples require separate installed acceptance before support is claimed.

decisions.question: What performance budgets matter and how are they measured?
decisions.current_direction: Measure small kernel calls, vector/batch services, workbook recalculation, optimization and live application work separately.

decision_record.selected_direction: Use six separately measured performance classes for scalar kernels, member batches, candidate search, serialization, installed workbook work and ETABS acquisition. Bind each claim to a frozen dataset, target environment, percentile, memory budget and cancellation rule; require a warm typical 20-member workbook p95 of at most one second and progress/cancellation response within 250 ms.
downstream_effects: PF11 work packets carry their applicable benchmark IDs.
Kernel timing cannot substitute for workbook or installed ETABS evidence.
Release evidence reports the exact dataset, environment, samples and percentile for every performance claim.

decisions.question: How will existing callers migrate and how are breaking semantic corrections versioned?
decisions.current_direction: Translate legacy calls through explicit compatibility paths where meanings are recoverable; version semantic/data/schema changes visibly.

decision_record.selected_direction: Cover every audited public surface through ordered disposition groups. Move beam callers to PF5 semantic operations, retain supported non-beam Python contracts in Python, use visible compatibility translations only where old meanings are recoverable, and refuse ambiguous inputs. Version packages, semantic operations, schemas, profiles, code data, assurance corpora, workbooks, adapters and report templates independently.
downstream_effects: Implementation packets include explicit caller migration and compatibility evidence.
Semantic corrections are visible and cannot be hidden in a package patch number.
Existing Python users retain an ordinary library route without Excel.

decisions.question: What documentation and examples make the library usable without the Excel product?
decisions.current_direction: Provide task-oriented small calculations, complete member workflows and separate Excel/ETABS guides backed by the same contracts.

decision_record.selected_direction: Publish task-oriented Python and .NET quickstarts, concepts and semantic-operation references before adapter guides. Use nine curricula that progress from small quantities through complete member and construction outputs to Excel, ETABS, coupled reanalysis and reviewer replay, all backed by the same contracts and examples.
downstream_effects: WP01 starts documentation with normal Python and .NET use.
Excel and ETABS guides consume library contracts rather than define engineering formulas.
Examples become source-linked assurance and learning assets instead of disconnected demos.

decisions.question: What is the safest and most valuable order of implementation?
decisions.current_direction: Use bounded vertical packets that prove semantics, both language projections and assurance before application integration expands.

decision_record.selected_direction: Implement twelve dependency-ordered work packets in three milestone PRs: eight pure dual-language library packets, one standalone Excel packet, and three ETABS/coupled/release-readiness packets. Use multiple reviewable commits inside each milestone. Begin with WP01, a host-free contracts-and-flexure slice that proves semantic, schema, data, conformance, compatibility and documentation authorities in Python and .NET.
downstream_effects: The first implementation scope is WP01 exactly as bounded in PF11-D6.
Standalone Excel follows a complete reusable member/search foundation.
ETABS mutation and reanalysis follow getter-only snapshot evidence and remain on owned model copies.
Publication continues to require the repository release gates and owner authorization.
